items.item:
5. A start whose store is made new and whose listener then cannot be opened
   stops, serves nothing and removes that store — or, when the removal
   fails, leaves it as an empty store of the release's version; one whose
   listener cannot be opened over an existing store leaves that store's
   records as they were. An owner-only start opens no service API listener.
   Shows A17-1. [witness: verification:registry_a17_listener_failure_serves_nothing_keeps_store]


verdicts.why: The check detects listener-start failures, verifies that nothing is served, that a newly created store is removed, that an existing store remains unchanged, and that an owner-only start has no service listener. It does not exercise the removal-failure branch leaving an empty versioned store, does not establish the full general implication that every serving configuration passed all checks, and does not assert secret pairwise distinctness or minimum byte length.
